items.title: Business Continuity Foundations
items.summary: Introduces business continuity concepts, objectives and governance.
objectives: Relate continuity to risk and impact

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Introduces business continuity concepts, objectives and governance. This lesson focuses on practical understanding, decision-making and evidence-based GRC practice.
bullets: Relate continuity to risk and impact

sections.heading: Key concepts
sections.body: Core concepts for business continuity foundations are explained in plain language, with emphasis on roles, controls, risks and expected outcomes in an enterprise context.

sections.heading: Application
sections.body: Learners should be able to apply the concepts to realistic scenarios, justify decisions, and recognise common gaps or weaknesses.

examples.title: Applying Business Continuity Foundations
examples.context: A team must address business continuity foundations in a business scenario with limited time and resources.
examples.outcome: A risk-informed, documented decision with clear ownership and follow-up actions.

practicalExercise.title: Exercise: Business Continuity Foundations
practicalExercise.brief: Apply the lesson to a fictional organisation facing challenges related to business continuity foundations.
practicalExercise.deliverable: A short action plan with rationale.
